value.quote: satisfies probabilistic do no harm and probabilistic positive gain with respect
value.note: All main results (Theorems 1-3, via Lemma 1) show that behavioural delegation models keep concentration of power bounded so that the gain in probability of identifying the ground truth relative to direct voting is non-negative/positive; this is performance against an epistemic accuracy objective (WD). The 'properties' are accuracy-performance criteria satisfied by models of voter behaviour, not axioms characterising or classifying aggregation rules, so AX is not coded.

C1.reason: Do-no-harm and positive-gain are accuracy-performance criteria against the ground truth satisfied by behavioural delegation models rather than axiomatic properties of a rule, so WD alone applies (B's codes kept, with a verbatim 11-word quote replacing B's over-long quote about prior work).
